name: Canva
description: Canva is a template-based design tool for social posts, presentations, resumes and simple logos, made for people who are not designers.
features: Templates for social posts, presentations and documents
limitations: Popular templates look familiar, so customise colours and text
Check commercial-use terms for specific content before client work
Prices differ by country; the amounts we recorded are in Pakistani rupees and per year only

free.details: Canva Free includes the drag-and-drop editor, 1.6M+ templates, 5GB of cloud storage and limited access to Standard and Premium AI.

pricing.trial: Canva Pro and Canva Business show a free trial option on the pricing page.

plans.name: Pro
plans.billing: Shown as Rs 9,200 per year for one person
plans.note: Yearly view, shown in PKR for a Pakistan visitor: Rs 9,200 per year for one person. Monthly and USD prices not captured.

plans.name: Business
plans.billing: Shown as Rs 16,000 per year per person
plans.note: Yearly view, shown in PKR for a Pakistan visitor: Rs 16,000 per year per person. Monthly and USD prices not captured.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.note: Contact sales; 1TB storage, SSO and SCIM, dedicated success manager for 150+ contracted seats

pricing.regional: Canva showed these prices in rupees (Rs), per year, for the region this page was opened from (Pakistan). Other countries see different currencies and prices, and USD and monthly prices were not captured. Do not treat the rupee amounts as a universal price.
notes: AI Pass is an extra-cost add-on for Pro and Business.
K-12 educational organisations and not-for-profits can get most premium features free (pricing page FAQ).

verification.notes: Product active. The pricing page opened for a Pakistan visitor in rupees on the Yearly view: Free Rs 0, Pro Rs 9,200 per year for one person, Business Rs 16,000 per year per person; Enterprise is contact sales. Pro and Business show a free-trial button. Re-checked on 2 Nov 2026: the Pakistan view still shows Free Rs 0, Pro Rs 9,200 per year and Business Rs 16,000 per year per person (Enterprise: get in touch), and clicking the Monthly toggle did not change the figures shown, so a monthly price could not be read. No USD prices appear for a Pakistan visitor, so it stays partially verified.

profile.headline: A visual suite for designing posts, videos, presentations and more

capabilities.title: Make AI-powered social posts, videos and presentations
capabilities.text: Canva's own line: make AI-powered social posts, videos, presentations and more.

capabilities.title: Fix and prepare images
capabilities.text: Clean up photos with Magic Eraser, remove image backgrounds in one click, and sharpen photos with Image Upscaler.

capabilities.title: Turn an image into an editable layout
capabilities.text: Magic Layers converts an image into an editable layout.

capabilities.title: Write with AI help
capabilities.text: Magic Write is Canva's tool for improving your writing.

featureCards.name: Magic Resize
featureCards.text: Resize a design instantly for any channel.

featureCards.name: Presentations and animations
featureCards.text: Create presentations and bring them to life with animations.

featureCards.name: Video editor and templates
featureCards.text: Turn clips into content, with trending video templates and studio-quality stock videos.

featureCards.name: AI captions
featureCards.text: Boost engagement with AI-powered captions on video.

featureCards.name: Apps
featureCards.text: Use Canva with your favourite apps.

audienceDetail.text: Canva calls itself a Visual Suite for Everyone.
Canva Business is described as built for small businesses with big aspirations.
Canva Enterprise is an end-to-end platform for large organisations.

scenarios.title: Build a presentation from a template
scenarios.text: Start from a presentation template and add animations.

scenarios.title: Publish one design in many sizes
scenarios.text: Use Magic Resize to adapt a design for each channel.

scenarios.title: Clean up a product photo
scenarios.text: Remove the background or an unwanted object, then upscale the image.

scenarios.title: Make a short video
scenarios.text: Start from a trending video template and add AI captions.

gettingStarted.text: Use the Get started for free button on canva.com.
Browse templates for presentations, social posts and video.
Set up a Brand Kit so designs stay on-brand.
Teams can explore Canva Business or Canva Enterprise.
